DC.name: transfer
DC.desc: Stream data is being sent and received correctly. Connection close completes with a zero error code.

LR.name: longrtt
LR.desc: Handshake completes when RTT is long.

M.name: multiplexing
M.desc: Thousands of files are transferred over a single connection, and server increased stream limits to accomodate client requests.

S.name: retry
S.desc: Server sends a Retry, and a subsequent connection using the Retry token completes successfully.

A.name: amplificationlimit
A.desc: The server obeys the 3x amplification limit.

B.name: blackhole
B.desc: Transfer succeeds despite underlying network blacking out for a few seconds.

U.name: keyupdate
U.desc: One of the two endpoints updates keys and the peer responds correctly.

L1.name: handshakeloss
L1.desc: Handshake completes under extreme packet loss.

L2.name: transferloss
L2.desc: Transfer completes under moderate packet loss.

C1.name: handshakecorruption
C1.desc: Handshake completes under extreme packet corruption.

C2.name: transfercorruption
C2.desc: Transfer completes under moderate packet corruption.

BP.name: rebind-port
BP.desc: Transfer completes under frequent port rebindings on the client side.

BA.name: rebind-addr
BA.desc: Transfer completes under frequent IP address and port rebindings on the client side.

V2.name: v2
V2.desc: Server should select QUIC v2 in compatible version negotiation.

R.name: resumption
R.desc: Connection is established using TLS Session Resumption.

Z.name: zerortt
Z.desc: 0-RTT data is being sent and acted on.
